info.title: API.SH: Prop971
info.description: The Prop971 API from API.SH: public Prop971 data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
One Prop971 off-plan project by its id (as in /prop971/v1/projects), its link or its slug: developer profile, location and coordinates, starting price in the chosen currency and in AED, price per sq ft and price trend figures, unit types and floor plans with sizes and starting prices, payment plan with each step, handover quarter, construction and sales status, construction start, completion and inspection dates where published, amenities, images, master plan, brochure, video, description, area description, nearby landmarks with travel times, the listing phone number and registration details where published, plus the similar projects the page shows (same fields). `raw` holds the site's full record.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/prop971-project

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A project id such as PRJ-RAD-YX3G6, a project link such as https://www.prop971.com/project/PRJ-RAD-YX3G6, or a project slug such as trace-park.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency for prices. Default AED.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The Prop971 directory of off-plan projects in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and the other emirates, with every filter of its search panel: text search, property type, construction status, sales status, handover quarter, city, area, developer, price and size ranges, amenities and payment-plan split. Each project carries its developer (name, logo, website, profile), location (address, area, city, coordinates), starting price in the chosen currency and in AED, price per sq ft, price trend figures, unit types and floor plans with sizes and starting prices, payment plan and its steps, handover quarter, status, amenities, images, master plan, brochure, video, description, nearby landmarks with travel times and the listing phone number, plus `raw` with the site's full record. City, area and developer take names or the ids the projects carry (`city_id`, `area_id`, `developer.id`); `applied_filters` shows what each name matched. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. `total` counts every match.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/prop971-projects

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words to search for in project names (200 characters at most).

parameters.name: property_type
parameters.description: One or more property types, separated by commas.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Construction status.

parameters.name: sales_status
parameters.description: One or more sales labels, separated by commas.

parameters.name: handover
parameters.description: Handover quarter, such as Q2 2030.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City (emirate) name or id, such as Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ras Al Khaimah, Ajman, Umm Al Quwain or Fujairah.

parameters.name: area
parameters.description: One or more area (community) names or ids, separated by commas, such as JVC or Dubai Marina. A name shared by several areas matches all of them; pass `city` to narrow it.

parameters.name: developer
parameters.description: One or more developer names or ids, separated by commas, such as Emaar or Sobha.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Lowest starting price, in the chosen currency.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest starting price, in the chosen currency.

parameters.name: min_size
parameters.description: Smallest unit size in sq ft.

parameters.name: max_size
parameters.description: Largest unit size in sq ft.

parameters.name: amenities
parameters.description: One or more amenities, separated by commas, such as Gym, Golf, Shared Swimming Pool or Smart Home (the site's own list; an unknown name answers 400 with the list).

parameters.name: down_payment
parameters.description: Payment plans with this down payment, in percent.

parameters.name: construction_payment
parameters.description: Payment plans with this share paid during construction, in percent.

parameters.name: handover_payment
parameters.description: Payment plans with this share paid on handover, in percent.

parameters.name: featured
parameters.description: true for the projects Prop971 features on its home page only.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order. Default is the site's own order.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Direction for `sort`. Default asc.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency for prices and for `min_price`/`max_price`. Default AED.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, from 1. Use `next_page` from the previous answer.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Projects per page. Default 15, at most 50.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
